comparison.objective: Extract an individual terminal from inside a connector housing; record unplugs an entire USB-C plug and then stores the welder.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert a blade beneath an internal locking tab and pull blade plus wire together versus stabilize a device and pull an externally graspable plug axially by its body.
comparison.success_condition: Chosen terminal exits while housing, crimp, and neighboring terminals remain intact versus plug out by hand, plug set down, and welder released in its holder. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The shared generic primitive is connector withdrawal, but the candidate uniquely tests access to and release of an internal retention lance.
